title: The Rencontres du Film Court begins
description: The Rencontres du Film Court de Madagasikara was created in 2006 on the initiative of Laza Razanajatovo. The festival became a durable meeting point for screenings, training, professional exchange and the discovery of new filmmakers, and later developed into a pan-African competition.

sources.note: Creation date recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; the festival's own archives should become the principal source.
